title: Baby tooth extraction
what: A pediatric dentist gently removes a baby tooth with local numbing. It is usually quick.
why: When a baby tooth is loose and in the way of the adult tooth, or is badly decayed or infected and cannot be saved.
tell_doctor: Your child's illnesses and allergies, especially to numbing medicines
If your child bruises easily or bleeds for a long time
If your child is scared. The dentist will find the right approach

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Feed your child 1 to 2 hours before the visit. After the extraction, no eating for 2 hours.

prepare.title: Mindset
prepare.text: Calmly tell your child the dentist will help the tooth. Do not scare them, and do not promise it will not hurt at all.

prepare.title: Health
prepare.text: If your child has a fever or a cold, call the clinic. The visit may be moved.

steps: The dentist checks the tooth and sometimes takes an X-ray
A numbing gel is put on the gum
Once the gum is numb, the tooth is removed
A cotton pad is placed on the spot. Your child bites down on it
feel: The injection is a quick pinch after the gel
Then the lip and cheek go numb for 1 to 3 hours
During the extraction: pressure, but no pain
after: Keep the cotton pad bitten down for 15 to 20 minutes
No eating for 2 hours, until the numbness wears off
Make sure your child does not bite the numb lip or cheek
On the day, no hot food, no rinsing, and do not touch the socket
red_flags: The socket is still bleeding an hour after biting on the cotton pad
Cheek swelling, a fever, or severe pain after 1 to 2 days

faq.q: When will the adult tooth come in?
faq.a: It varies: sometimes in a few weeks, sometimes later. If the tooth was removed early, the dentist may suggest a device to keep the space.

faq.q: Can I pull a loose tooth at home?
faq.a: If the tooth is very loose and almost out, it often falls out on its own. If the gum hurts or is inflamed, see a dentist.

reminders.text: Your child's tooth extraction is soon. Feed your child beforehand. No eating for 2 hours after.
